segments.name: Container vessels segment
segments.description: Charters its owned containership fleet to charterers worldwide, providing marine transportation services and earning voyage revenue.
segments.evidence: ( 1 ) a container vessels segment, as a provider of worldwide marine transportation services by chartering its container vessels

segments.name: NML
segments.description: Acquires, owns and bareboat charters out vessels through wholly-owned subsidiaries to lessees, earning leaseback income.
segments.evidence: NML acquires, owns and bareboat charters out vessels through its wholly-owned subsidiaries.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay charter hire to use the container vessels, while lessees pay bareboat charter hire to NML's vessel-owning subsidiaries.
revenueModel.evidence: Neptune acquires and charters out on a bareboat basis vessels to customers (lessees) through wholly-owned subsidiaries.

changes.text: The dry bulk and CBI operating platform segments were spun off, leaving two reportable segments from four.
changes.evidence: Prior to the Spin-Off, there were four reportable segments; however, the dry bulk and CBI operating platform segments were spun off, and the comparative information has been recast accordingly.
